items.title: Leslie Gourse interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: she heard a singer on the radio, Kevin Mahogany, and she had never heard him before but from the way that he was singing and the way I had described him to her, she knew who it was.

ctx.x: —so that I could hear it again.

Yes. A girlfriend last night, Joanne Brackeen plays piano and told me she heard a singer on the radio, Kevin Mahogany, and she had never heard him before but from the way that he was singing and the way I had described him to her, she knew who it was. So that’s wonderful. I do have that ability, to tell people what it sounds like, to bridge the gap. I’m not a musicologist, and I do not try to be nor want to be. I just don’t. But I do want people to have the feeling that they know something of what’s going on…
Do you feel that you have to be part detective when you write these books?
